CI builds with Emscripten 6.0.9, but the Docker image still installed 3.1.56,
on an Ubuntu release whose package mirrors are gone.

- Move to Ubuntu 24.04 LTS. Ubuntu 23.10 reached end of life in July 2024,
  so `apt-get update` fails on a fresh build.
- Add the Google Chrome key as a `signed-by` keyring, since 24.04 ships no
  `apt-key`.
- Drop `chromium-browser`, which on 24.04 only installs the snap, and snaps
  do not run in containers. The image gets Chrome from Google's repository.
- Install Emscripten 6.0.9, the version CI uses, and point the cleanup at
  where emsdk now keeps the test suite and docs.
- Bump the image tag so Docker Compose builds the new image in place of
  pulling the published 0.75.
- Set `EXEC_ENVIRONMENT` as a Make variable. The `set_environment` recipe set
  it in its own shell, which never reached the other recipes, so builds
  without emcc on the PATH never ran in the
